title: 游玩专家
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art for achievement_medal_travel_tier_004, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Primary request: Create one absurd but controlled premium collectible travel achievement medal for the Chinese achievement title concept "游玩专家" (play/travel expert, enjoys trips paid by others). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a beveled gold rim and glossy teal enamel center, more luxurious than tier 3. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold travel suitcase wearing oversized cheap black sunglasses, lounging smugly in a tiny first-class airplane seat. The suitcase and the first-class seat are the only main elements. Add only two large star glints as lighting.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, intentionally silly, premium material finish, raised metal relief, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: clear large silhouette, suitcase centered and dominant, seat readable but not complex. No airplane, no cabin background, no extra travel props.
Lighting/mood: bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, smug luxury comedy.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold, electric teal enamel, coral accent on rim, black sunglasses, deep red or navy first-class seat, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, plush seat, beveled rim, subtle hand-painted shading. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
